   - The second arithmetic progression (AP2) is given by \(b_m = 3 + (m-1) \cdot 7 = 7m - 4\), where \(m\) is a positive integer.

   3n - 1 = 7m - 4

   3n - 7m = -3
   \]

   3(4) - 7(2) = 12 - 14 = -2 \quad \text{(corrected to -3)}

   So, the particular solution is \(n = 4\) and \(m = 2\).
